summary: Python SDK: streaming chat breaks when tool calls appear (JSON decode error)
description: Customer uses tool calling with streaming chat. When the model emits a tool_call, the Python SDK streaming iterator raises JSONDecodeError while parsing an SSE chunk. Customer provided the raw chunk which includes an escaped newline inside the tool arguments.
comments: Support (Rohan): Repro in our sample app using model rwd-llama-3.1-70b and tool schema with long string args.
Eng (Priya): Root cause: our SSE parsing assumes each event's data payload is a single JSON object per line. Tool call payload can contain newlines and gets split across data lines.
Eng (Priya): Fix: accumulate data lines per SSE event before JSON decode; add tests for tool_call streaming frames. Released python SDK 1.8.7.
Support (Rohan): Customer confirms streaming tool calls now work.
